semantics.transition: At each falling edge, q becomes 8'h34 if reset is high; otherwise q becomes the sampled d.
semantics.reset: Active-high synchronous reset, with priority over data capture; changing reset alone does not update q.
semantics.hold: q holds between falling edges, including rising edges and input changes.
semantics.initialization: No power-up value specified; no initialization logic required. Only check known output after a falling edge.
semantics.latency: Registered update at the sampling falling edge, visible after nonblocking assignments; one update per falling edge.

numeric.arithmetic: None; bit-exact copy without rounding, saturation, extension, or truncation.

verification.oracle: Independent testbench expected value updated from reset and d only at falling edges, compared after NBA settling.
cases: All 256 data byte values with reset asserted
Hold during off-edge data and reset changes
Reset pulses that end before a falling edge do not alter q
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog 12, -g2012, explicit dev_tb top, finite shell timeouts and testbench watchdog
